item.title: Heritage Ballet Brings The Nutcracker to Woonsocket's Stadium Theatre
item.description: Heritage Ballet performs The Nutcracker at the Stadium Theatre in Woonsocket on Sat., Nov. 28 at 2 and 7 p.m. and Sun., Nov. 29 at 2 p.m.

item.title: The Community Players Open Their Season With Bye Bye Birdie in Pawtucket
item.description: The Community Players open their season with Bye Bye Birdie at Jenks Auditorium in Pawtucket, with performances Nov. 13 to 22; dates vary, so check showtimes.

item.title: Helena Foulkes Wins Rhode Island Governor's Race in a Three-Way Contest
item.description: The Democrat and former CVS executive took about 57.5 percent of the vote over independent Ken Block and Republican Aaron Guckian.

item.title: Voters Approve Three State Bonds, Reject Two for First Time Since 2006
item.description: Rhode Islanders backed $445 million for colleges, housing and the green economy but turned down $150 million for economic development and the cultural economy.

item.title: David Morales, 28, Elected Providence Mayor With About 81 Percent of the Vote
item.description: The state representative becomes the youngest mayor in the city's history and has promised to bring back rent stabilization within his first 100 days.

item.title: Trinity Rep Marks 50 Years of A Christmas Carol
item.description: The Providence company's golden-anniversary production, directed by Taavon Gamble, plays Nov. 5 through Dec. 31 in the Dowling Theater.

item.title: Rhode Island Today and Tonight: Gatsby, Gratitude and Almost, Maine
item.description: Gatsby's 6:30 p.m. curtain at PPAC leads today's picks, with Almost, Maine at 2 p.m. in West Warwick and a 3 p.m. gratitude concert in Warren.

item.title: Gamm Stages Arthur Miller's A View From the Bridge This November
item.description: This November at the Gamm Theatre in Warwick, with dates and curtain times listed on the theatre's season page.

item.title: RIC Chorus Sings Carols and Light in Sapinsley Hall on Nov. 13
item.description: Friday, Nov. 13 at 7:30 p.m. in Sapinsley Hall at the Nazarian Center, 115 First Avenue, Providence, with paid admission.

item.title: Songs of Gratitude Mark St. Mary of the Bay's 175th Anniversary
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 8 at 3 p.m. at St. Mary of the Bay, 645 Main Street, Warren, with Michael DiMucci in voice and piano.

item.title: NaBSCO Community Orchestra Opens Its Season in East Providence
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 8 at 3 p.m. in the East Providence High School auditorium, 2000 Pawtucket Avenue, with John Eells conducting and pay-what-you-can admission.

item.title: Greek Food Fair and Christmas Bazaar Opens Sunday in Cranston
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 8 from 11 a.m. at the Church of the Annunciation, 175 Oaklawn Avenue, Cranston, with admission at no charge.

item.title: Everybody Chorus Welcomes Jamestown Singers of All Ages
item.description: Saturday, Nov. 14 at 9:30 a.m. at the Jamestown Recreation Center, 41 Conanicus Avenue, with an informal singing hour open to all ages.

item.title: An evening on abstract art with Sheila Isham's work in Newport
item.description: Wednesday, Nov. 18 at 5:30 p.m. at the Newport Art Museum, 76 Bellevue Avenue in Newport, with no charge but limited tickets to reserve online.

item.title: Molly Kugler Dickinson's round panels open at Jamestown Arts Center
item.description: Friday, Nov. 20, from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. at the Jamestown Arts Center, 18 Valley Street in Jamestown, with the show on view through Jan. 9, 2027.

item.title: Young performers take the mic at Youth On the Mic in Westerly
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 22 at 5 p.m. at The Knick Music Lab, 35 Railroad Avenue in Westerly, with no charge for admission.

item.title: RISD Museum opens a 150-year look at how its collection grew
item.description: Opens Saturday, Nov. 21 at the RISD Museum, 20 North Main Street in Providence, and stays on view through Aug. 1, 2027.

item.title: Revolution Wind Reaches Full Power Off the Rhode Island Coast
item.description: The 704-megawatt, 65-turbine wind farm is now fully delivering electricity to the regional grid, about 14 months after a federal stop-work order paused construction.

item.title: Sheila Isham: Between Worlds at the Newport Art Museum Through Jan. 4
item.description: Open Monday and Wednesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., at the Newport Art Museum, 76 Bellevue Avenue, Newport, with the exhibition running through Jan. 4, 2027.

item.title: Environmental Currents: Art and Ocean Science at URI's Studio Blue
item.description: Open Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., at Studio Blue on URI's Narragansett Bay Campus in Narragansett, through Nov. 18, with no charge admission.

item.title: Armenian Fest Returns to Rhodes on the Pawtuxet in Cranston
item.description: Saturday, Nov. 14, noon to 8 p.m., and Sunday, Nov. 15, noon to 7 p.m., at Sts. Vartanantz Armenian Apostolic Church's Rhodes on the Pawtuxet, 60 Rhodes Place, Cranston.

item.title: Joe Parillo and the New Ensemble Bring Lily Pads Jazz to Peace Dale
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 15, doors at 3 p.m. and the show from 3:30 to 5:30 p.m., at the Unitarian Universalist Congregation of South County in Peace Dale.

item.title: Happy Mail: Jamestown Library Makes Thank-You Postcards on Nov. 14
item.description: Saturday, Nov. 14, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. in the Sydney Wright Room of the Jamestown Philomenian Library, 26 North Road, Jamestown.

item.title: Rusty Pens: A Weekly Writing Workshop for Jamestown Beginners
item.description: Mondays from Nov. 9 through Feb. 22, 10:30 to 11:30 a.m., in the Sydney Wright Room of the Jamestown Philomenian Library, 26 North Road, Jamestown.

item.title: Get the Rhode Island Hurricane App
item.description: Put Rhode Island Hurricane on your phone's home screen or your computer's desktop and open it with one tap, like any other app.

item.title: This Weekend in Rhode Island: Comic Con, The Great Gatsby and WaterFire for Veterans
item.description: Comic Con fills the Convention Center, The Great Gatsby plays PPAC, WaterFire honors veterans Saturday night, and church bazaars open the holiday shopping season, Nov. 6 to 8.

item.title: Stargazing Nights at Frosty Drew Observatory in Charlestown
item.description: Next dated session: Friday, Nov. 13, 7 to 9 p.m., weather permitting, with $5 admission per person.

item.title: Thanksgiving in Rhode Island: The 2026 Guide
item.description: Turkey trots, community meals, places to volunteer, Thanksgiving Masses and about 30 restaurants serving dinner on Thursday, Nov. 26.

item.title: Ringing In 2027: Rhode Island's New Year's Eve Guide
item.description: Noon countdowns, Providence's riverfront fireworks, tasting dinners, black-tie balls, live bands and comedy across the state on Thursday, Dec. 31.

item.title: Rhode Island's 2026 Christmas Season Events Guide
item.description: Dates, times and prices for Trinity Rep, Cirque du Soleil, the Boston Pops, The Nutcracker, the Newport mansions, tree lightings and light displays statewide.
